headline: Mideast Tensions & Rising Oil Prices
detail: Escalating tensions in the Middle East and rising oil prices typically fuel inflation fears and a risk-off sentiment. This can put pressure on growth stocks, including your concentrated tech/chip holdings, as investors seek safer assets.
rec: No action needed directly from this headline, but be aware of the broader market implications for your leveraged positions.

headline: AI Fuels Cyberattack Threat
detail: Interpol warns that AI is making cyberattacks more sophisticated and harder to detect. This highlights both a growing threat to tech companies and a potential increased demand for advanced cybersecurity solutions, directly relevant to your CRWD holding.
rec: No direct trade from this headline, but it reinforces the long-term relevance of your CRWD position.
